answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Proof-of-work activation: a new key must solve a puzzle bound to the epoch seed, about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 660 fakes pays 440 CPU-minutes every epoch, while one honest agent pays once. A rented botnet still pays the same seconds per key, so the farm's bill scales linearly. The oasis of the design is public, the raven of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the delta of honest work is what finally pays. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
